description: This file defines the Goteo\Library\Check class, providing various static methods for validation purposes, such as verifying identification numbers (NIF, NIE, CIF, VAT, Siret, RFC), email addresses, passwords, words count, phone numbers, country detection, and table reordering functionalities.

classes.name: Check
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to validate different types of data, including identification numbers, emails, passwords, and more, as well as methods for database-based reordering operations.

methods.name: nif
methods.description: Validates Spanish identification numbers such as NIF, NIE, CIF, and specific formats like VAT, SIRET, and RFC for various countries.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Validates the structure and format of an email address.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Checks if a password meets minimum length criteria (at least 6 characters).

methods.name: words
methods.description: Verifies if the text contains at least a specified number of words.

methods.name: phone
methods.description: Validates phone numbers comprising 9 to 14 digits.

methods.name: country
methods.description: Returns the country name, currently hardcoded to 'España'.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Reorders entries in a database table by moving a record up or down, updating the 'order' field accordingly.

methods.name: reorderDecrease
methods.description: Decreases the order of a record, effectively moving it upward in the ordering sequence.

methods.name: time_togo
methods.description: Calculates the time remaining until a given date, returning a human-readable string.

search-terms: NIF NIE CIF VAT SIRET RFC validation
